title: About Me
text: Lauren Walker is a student at Colgate University who is looking to study biostatistics and data science. Lauren is currently applying to M.S. and M.P.H programs in Biostatistics. Outside of academics, Lauren loves to spend time with her dog, Skye, and watch movies with her friends!

Welcome!
